title: ORL fixed factorial study: sigma by context
caption: Historical protocol study; not the current matched Euclidean headline. Whiskers are split SD. The effects are descriptive on repeated images. Context improves CSA24, but reducing sigma under context lowers CSA390; the settings are not jointly optimal for every method.

title: ORL three fixed inputs: improvements and regressions
caption: Historical protocol study; not the current matched Euclidean headline. 120 outer fits; all negative branches retained. Context is a field-of-view extension and TT+HE is a photometric extension. This ten-split batch differs from the twenty-split factorial study.

title: Gallery-only staged selection: most gain comes early
caption: Historical protocol study; not the current matched Euclidean headline. Inputs include context/power extensions. CSA24 stages A->C add only about 0.03pp, and other controls can decline. Inner validation improvement does not guarantee outer improvement; this is not a blind new dataset.

title: Crop-only bounded optimization: small gain, negative controls
caption: Historical protocol study; not the current matched Euclidean headline. Dark: matched baseline; orange: validation-selected final setting. CSA24 improves only 0.16pp, while CSA390 and both PCA controls decline. Do not substitute this result for the context extension.

caption: Historical protocol study; not the current matched Euclidean headline. Ten splits; sample SD whiskers. More fitting/gallery images change both representation estimation and NN coverage. G5/P5 is an extension, not the original G2/P8 experiment; no original-paper threshold is drawn.

title: MNIST bounded selection: preserve the negative result
caption: CSA declines by 0.77pp at G30 and 0.32pp at G40. These are ten-seed paired results, not changes from the three-seed main-reference means. All failed stages remain archived.

caption: Historical Gabor/alignment version; not the new HOSVD/context recognition input. Learning-sample tensor reconstruction, not Gabor inversion or unseen-face generalization. Original absolute Gabor scale/pointwise curve values are unavailable; compare qualitative trends.

caption: Historical protocol study; not the current matched Euclidean headline. These are projected-energy ratios, not percentages of identity information or accuracy.
